hints.title: Fast Membership Lookup
hints.text: Store all numbers in a lookup collection to enable fast membership testing.

hints.title: Simulation Loop
hints.text: While the current value of original exists in the hash set, double it.

hints.title: Termination
hints.text: When original is no longer present in the set, return its current value.
